notes.title: Version 2.4 Release Notes
notes.notes:
IMPORTANT NOTICE
If you own the Patron of the Old Gods, make sure to log in monthly to claim your Gems.

BALANCE CHANGES
(Missed from the previous update) Tombstone Mimic now costs 5 Mana and has stats of 3/4.
Indentured Servitude no longer has the Discarded ability.
Lowly Lieutenant is now classified as an Underling and no longer has the Discarded ability.
Grand Tutoring now costs 9 Mana.
Sell-Sword no longer has the Loophole ability. Its Last Word effect is now: "ALL players gain 1 Life."

ADDED
Dante now assists new and existing players who created their accounts after December 1st, 2024, introducing mechanics that players may not have encountered before.

UPDATES
Dante has been polished with new facial features and repositioning to better suit VR players during tutorials.
Slick Grifter and Something Wicked Approaches had their text updated for consistency with other cards.
Trapjaw Stump and Hungry Mimic now include "When blocked" in their descriptions for uniformity.
Unlawful Trespass has been raised from Common to Rare.
Mystic Envisioner has been reduced from Uncommon to Common.

FIXES
The Guidebook now correctly displays milestone limits as 100 instead of 50.
A typo in the quest "Kill 5 creatures with damaging spells" has been corrected.
Masters no longer trigger "deals direct damage" abilities like Messenger Raven when taking damage.
Masters taking damage no longer incorrectly increment the Reduce your opponent’s Life Total quest.
Players will no longer draw cards if a game is forfeited during the "first person" or "redraw" steps.
The Summon Mastery Creatures quest now correctly increments for creatures granted Mastery.
The Summon Taunt Creatures quest now accounts for copies of creatures granted Taunt.
Creatures summoned by Grand Tutoring with Summon Copy abilities now correctly apply stat changes.
Copies of Amped creatures that lose the Amped status (via suppression or theft) will no longer be summoned Unexhausted.
Cunning Snaremaster’s first ability now correctly increases the damage of all Banes, not just opponents'.
Visual artifacts in Flatscreen BattleCam caused by creatures being removed too early have been resolved.
Flatscreen players no longer encounter errors when performing gestures or swapping havens.
The watch menu’s Havens page now correctly displays as Havens, not Taverns.
On Android, cards in hand will no longer become unplayable after swapping apps.
VR players now receive proper error messaging when attempting to block Flight or Loophole creatures.
Tombstone Mimic no longer exhausts itself when copying Amped creatures.
Skill Siphoner now only copies active attributes from its target, ignoring disabled or suppressed ones.
A missing tooltip explaining why a creature could not block another (if eligible to block something else) has been added.
Exiting a ranked battle now transitions background music without errors.

notes.title: Version 2.3.2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
IMPORTANT NOTICE:
Hardware requirements for Cards & Tankards on Android devices have been changed, now requiring 4+ GB Ram and Android 11 or newer. Download today on the Google Play Store!
You will now need to log-in monthly if you have Patron of the Old Gods to receive your Gems.

BALANCE CHANGES:
Field Bureaucrat no longer has a Discarded ability, and reduces the cost of the first spell it sees each turn.
Alkar, the Former Master is now 10 Mana with Mastery 2, and causes you to lose 1 Life for each spell you play.
Kira, Heroine of Garsang no longer raises her own health.
Mastercraft Flesh Golem is now 9 Mana 2/12.
Dreaded Corpse Flinger lowered from 3/3 to 2/3
Forbidden Lotus’s Enhance is now "To their Banish Zone instead for 3 Coins."
Mind Squander is now 2 Mana and no longer gives life.
Bone Amalgamates no longer give health as part of their Last Word.
Soul Extraction no longer draws a card if it gets a kill.
Cosmic Reanimation now causes all players to summon the top 3 creatures of their Graveyard, dooming them and making them Undead.
Torch Carrier’s Last Word now instead Shifts all Powder Kegs in all decks to the top.
Something Wicked Approaches + Grand Tutoring now only Fetch Non-Legendaries.
Wraith’s Wrath is reduced back to 5 damage.

ADDED:
A brand new Guide Book for providing information about aspects of the game, found in your Watch Menu at the top-right.
A completely re-done and shortened tutorial.
Automatic forfeiting if a player AFKs in ranked.
A new visual showing the game deciding which player gets the first turn.
Whilst deciding which player begins, faction banner flags matching the deck’s primary and secondary choices.
Brand new "Mana Fragment" system. The player going second will gain 1 at the beginning of the game.
Tooltips for when you attempt to block and are unable to do so along with why.
A large number of new quests – Augur-focused, gamemode-focused and attribute focused.

UPDATED:
All existing quests have had a overhaul to make them better to complete
Milestone Quests have been adjusted to allow greater rewards for more consecutive quest completion.
All summons not played directly from the hand are always summoned on the right side of the board.
Patron of the Old Gods subscription page now has a "Manage Subscription" button on Android.
Flatscreen players are now able to use spells by just dragging them like they would a creature.
A minor visual change to boost visibility when the quest board has rewards ready to be claimed.

FIXED:
Mystic Envisioner’s ability being triggered by Masters.
Flatscreen Battle Camera getting pieces stuck on-screen.
Flatscreen Zones screen can get stuck with no way to close it.
Flatscreen Redraw screen getting stuck with no way for you to click on it.
A visual issue where a Flatscreen player moving a card will make it appear to be clipping in their hand to others.
Endless Enforcers summoning copies even if it’s already died (in the instance of Multi-damaging abilities).
Channeled Destruction continues to activate even though its counter is 0.
Grow the Horde keeps waiting for you to make a second selection, even if you have no room.

notes.title: 1.2 Update: New Banish Synergy
notes.notes:
Hey Adventurers and Patrons!

Our next set of ||spoilers|| are from the [b]Dungeon Master Faction[/b]. This Mini-Expansion has been about filling spaces in Factions lacking in some way or needing help that simple card adjustments would not cover. Dungeon Master is not one of those factions. As one of, if not the most well-rounded Factions in the game, it proved challenging to make meaningful changes to existing decks.

So, we took a different direction and introduced something completely new. 
[h2][b]Banish Deck [/b][/h2]

Banish has always been the most permanent form of removal in the game, completely removing cards from the game. But what if there was one that just would not go away? Flipping the concept of Banish as a tool on its head, these new/reworked cards should add another tool to the tool belt of Dungeon Master.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39919787/0db25ed35accc07a78209632801303face108f8a.png[/img]

[h1]Banish Deck Synergy[/h1]
[h3][i][b]All outlined rebalances are subject to change before release. Nothing listed is final.[/b][/i][/h3]

[h2][b][u]Gunhaunt’s Call[/u][/b][/h2]
[i]The initial design of Gunhant’s Call was intended to give decks, not including its namesake Gunhaunt, a way to generate Desperados and give players a way to use leftover Mana. While it did this, it was overall unused in the game due to Desperados only having one health and a lack of overall synergies outside Gunhaunt. With this established, a clean slate was made, and with the addition of the concept of a Banish deck coming up, this new direction was taken. Inside a Banish deck, this is a significant tool for cycling Eternal Aetherite and gaining value from the stat loss. Outside, it’s a valuable tool to take care of enemy units that could have been harder to deal with using existing removal tools.[/i]

[h3][b]Old:[/b][/h3]
0 Mana Spell. Spend all your Mana. Summon a Desperado with attack equal to mana spent

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
1 Mana Spell.  Banish a friendly creature, then deal that creature’s attack to an enemy creature

[h2][u][b]Eternal Aetherite[/b][/u][/h2]
[i]This is the heart and soul of the new deck type. This new Elemental proves formidable as it refuses to stay gone. Its ability to navigate the Aether sees it coming back time and time again, bigger and better. Mix this with the new Banish tools and those in the game to get the most benefit. Just ensure you don’t commit too much to looping Eternal Aetherite, or you will find yourself out of cards.[/i]

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
5 Mana 2 Attack 2 Health Creature. When banished from any zone, this gains +2/+2 and is placed on top of its owner’s Deck.

[h2][u][b]Mind Squander[/b][/u][/h2]
[i]From a glance, this could look like a strange card. “Banish my hand for 5 cards and 5 health? Seems crazy!” At first glance, you would be correct. Banishing your entire hand would be a foolish choice in most cases. However, with the addition of Eternal Aetherite, this becomes another part of the Banish synergy that doesn’t leave you down a card. Outside that combo, smart players will be able to get great use out of Mind Squander as a tool for getting back into the game or get rid of some cards you don’t want for those you do.[/i]

[h3][b]New:[/b][/h3]
7 Mana Spell. Banish your hand, draw 5 cards, and gain 5 life.

This infusion of new life to the oldest faction in the game will surely spark inspiration and excitement from those dedicated to the Dark Arts.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Adventurers and Patrons!

We strive to give as many players as possible the best experience possible, but after months of implementation, it was clear that Age Restricted Taverns was not having the desired result of allowing players to have the experience they expect. Due to this, we are moving to a Reputation Based Tavern system. 

The concept is that as long as you are on and behaving, you will gain reputation and gain access to taverns with like-minded individuals. We expect this will improve all player's experiences as the system runs and you should all have a better time on average.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39919787/56bd97805b5a8bfa520b01cc82393209b4edb182.png[/img]

Additionally, we have added Draft Mode to the Tavern! Show your skill and select 40 cards at random to battle it out over 10 matches for increasingly better rewards! Will you conquer the map left by Maeve and claim the top prize?

Lastly, the Taunt keyword has been updated:

[i]A creature with Taunt must be blocked or targeted by the enemy first each turn.[/i]

This change has been made to give a counter-play to targeted damage and removal spells. Mastery has run the show for some time now and it is due in part to it's ability to ignore your creatures. This update will require Mastery players to first get rid of your taunt unit's effect in order to damage you directly. This change will improve Taunt's usability in the meta as well as tone down the rampant use of Mastery.

All in, this is a big update! If you want more details, as well as a few things I didn't cover here, check out the rest of the notes below:

[h2]Version 1.1 Release Notes:[/h2]
[u][b]Added:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Draft Mode, in the deck list, you will see a "Draft a Deck" option when your collection book is out
[*] Reputation based taverns which replace age restricted taverns
[*] Quill and Ink props that allow you to draw in the air
[*] Mana burn VFX
[*] Card draw and shuffle SFX
[*] Additional VFX for some MRA and PG cards
[*] Floating damage and heal numbers
[*] Pressed icon for watch menu back button
[*] Legit match detection system to prevent exploitation of battle rewards
[/list]

[u][b]Changed:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] New subscriptions purchased on Quest will now auto renew
[*] Animated cards now have a golden border
[*] Gems earned from the Season Pass can no longer be gifted to other players
[*] Reduced battery drain on Quest headsets

[*] Replaced Steam/email create account button icons
[*] Trophy props were moved under the Tankards category
[*] Progression Rewards was renamed to Season Rewards
[*] Updated the Season Pass poster to include ending date
[*] Improved the profanity filter to be less aggressive
[/list]

[u][b]Fixed:[/b][/u]

[/list]

[u][b]Balance Changes:[/b][/u]
